evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow… Special Edition About the Game On an expedition to save your fellow Explorers, you and your partner become the victims of bad timing, and are trapped beneath the ice of Antarctica. Once awakened, the world around the two of you is no longer the one you remember. With little recollection of what happened, you find yourselves inside a facility of Norček Industries, where the charismatic Director Kathleen Bowe is waiting for you. Her team was on the verge of a breakthrough, but they have mysteriously disappeared, leaving their work unfinished. With a global crisis looming, the Director turns to you and your partner to continue where they left off. To complete their work, you must take on a series of complex tasks throughout the facility. Often separated, you will rely solely on your walkie-talkies to communicate. Describe what you see, share what you discover, and combine your perspectives to solve the puzzles that stand in your way. But be cautious; the deeper you venture into the Norček facility, the more questions begin to surface. What is Norček trying to achieve? Why were you brought here? And what happened to those who came before you? Only together will you unravel the mysteries surrounding Norček Industries and discover the truth. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow. Key Features A shared adventure: When fate takes an unexpected turn, two Explorers find themselves trapped inside a mysterious facility. With only each other to rely on, they must uncover its secrets and decide what Tomorrow will hold. Asymmetrical co-op puzzling: No two Explorers experience the facility the same way. Trust your partner, communicate through your walkie-talkies, and combine your unique perspectives to solve puzzles that challenge the rules of time, gravity, and space. Two players, two distinct roles: You and your partner each have a different role to play, with your own high-tech tool at your disposal. Work together and use your equipment in creative ways to overcome obstacles that neither of you could face alone. A mystery in an imagined 80s future: Explore Norček Industries and uncover the secrets behind its experiments and missing research team. Journey through a retro-futuristic world brought to life by striking environments and a nostalgic synthwave soundtrack. The We Were Here Series Every game in the We Were Here Series is a standalone online co-op adventure – the stories are connected but you don’t need to play them in order. Playing with your friend and communicating well is key to the escape room series: asymmetrical puzzles give players different perspectives and can only be solved together. NOTE: This game is co-op only. It requires both players to have a working PC-compatible microphone and an internet connection. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality : Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself. Game Features Dynamic Story Generator : Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices. Relatability Meets Relaxation : Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure. Ultimate Freedom of Exploration : From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs : The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–4 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do. Join our community on Discord About the Game S.O.N.A.R. is a 1–4 player online co-op submarine simulator where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always just one wrong button away. Coordinate with your crew, use sonar to detect threats, and operate a cutting-edge submarine through combat operations, stealth infiltrations, and treasure recovery missions. Repair catastrophic malfunctions, recalibrate complex systems, and desperately hope that the person sitting next to you isn't just randomly pressing buttons. UNDERWATER MISSIONS The oceans are under enemy control. Gather a team of highly trained specialists (or at least people who claim they know what they're doing) and complete dangerous missions beneath the waves. - Locate hostile vessels with sonar and send them to the bottom of the sea. Preferably before they do the same to you. - Protect valuable cargo ships. Because apparently the military couldn't find anyone else to babysit them. - Hunt for treasures. Use sonar to search the ocean floor for lost riches, forgotten artifacts, and evidence of previous crews' poor decisions. - Slip past enemy destroyers undetected. Stay quiet. Stay hidden. And whatever you do, don't sneeze. COOPERATION Up to four crew members must work together to manage nine critical stations, including navigation, diving, sonar, periscope operations, engineering, and damage control. Your sonar operator tracks contacts while the rest of the crew keeps the submarine alive. When the sub catches fire or starts taking on water from twelve different holes at once, communication is the only thing standing between you and becoming fish food. Use proximity voice chat to: - Shout urgent orders. - Warn everyone about imminent disaster. - Explain why the catastrophe is definitely someone else's fault. And if a crewmate starts reading the manual during a torpedo attack, give ’em a friendly slap back to reality! Nothing says "successful mission" quite like a victory dance while all hell breaks loose. CUSTOMIZATION In S.O.N.A.R. every character is unique. Choose from dozens of uniforms, hats, and questionable fashion choices. Customize your equipment before deployment and unlock new gear as you level up. If you're going to make terrible decisions underwater, you should at least look good doing it. SURVIVAL Machines aren't the only things that break down. Humans do too. Manage your crew's food supplies, rest schedules, and overall well-being. Neglect them for too long and they'll become exhausted, seasick, delirious, or mysteriously incapable of following simple instructions. Health Tip: You really, really don't want to be vomiting inside your diving helmet when it's your turn to load the torpedoes. Trust us on this one. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: Jianghu Bounty Hunter is a solo open-world wuxia management game. Restore your ruined escort bureau with the ancient Mechanism Boat. Manage resources, trade, and fight with tower defense auto-battler gameplay. Seize territories and choose to be either a righteous hero or a ruthless jianghu overlord. Jianghu Bounty Hunter is a solo-developed open-world wuxia management game on Steam. It integrates caravan management, survival resource gathering, faction warfare, and tower defense auto-battler strategy gameplay. Powered by a dynamically interconnected living world system, it presents a vivid, unrestrained martial arts jianghu full of possibilities. 1. Core Lore During the chaotic Spring and Autumn Period, Fan Li forged an unparalleled divine treasure — the Zhu Tao Mechanism Boat. Endowed with incredible power, the boat helped the State of Wu restore its dynasty and end turmoil. After achieving greatness, Fan Li retired from public life. Using the boat’s ingenious mechanism technology, he dominated commerce and became the wealthiest sage of his era. Hundreds of years later, a Taoist priest from the Kongtong Sect discovered the sealed ancient vessel in a remote mountain cave while surveying feng shui. Harnessing its heaven-defying power, he reshaped the jianghu, conquered rival forces, unified the realm, and founded the Wu Dynasty, later honored as the Wu Ancestor. Knowing the boat’s power was too formidable and would trigger endless conflicts if leaked to the world, the Wu Ancestor resealed the artifact in an unknown hidden realm to secure lasting peace. As times changed and chaos returned to the jianghu, you awaken in the ruins of a massacred escort bureau with all memories lost. Guided by the old bureau accountant, you rediscover the long-lost Zhu Tao Mechanism Boat. Embark on a journey to revive your fallen escort agency and rise amid the turbulent martial arts world. 2. Core Game Systems 2.1 Immersive Survival & Management Experience realistic caravan simulation and meticulous bureau operation. Manage your guards’ daily lives, accommodation, and salaries. Poor resource supply, administrative negligence, or low team morale will deplete your Jianghu Reputation. Once reputation drops to zero, your bureau collapses and the game ends. Explore freely on foot or aboard your Mechanism Boat. Gather lumber, stone, fish, herbs and more. All resources can be sold directly or processed into advanced crafts and supplies. Build your own industrial chain for self-sufficiency and profitable trading. 2.2 Dynamic Interconnected World System The first chapter unlocks the entire Shu Region map, including 5 distinctive towns, dozens of resource-rich villages, and 15 influential sects. The whole world operates on a fully dynamic interconnected system where weather cycles, ecological changes, and commodity economies interact and influence one another in a real-time simulated ecosystem. Weather conditions affect exploration efficiency, trade route safety, and resource yields. Ecological abundance directly impacts market supply, driving real-time price fluctuations. Local specialties, sect goods, and rare relic resources circulate dynamically. Capitalize on shifting markets and chaotic situations to accumulate wealth and dominate regional trade. 2.3 Customizable Mechanism Boat — Mobile Stronghold The Zhu Tao Mechanism Boat serves as your upgradable, fully customizable mobile base. Redesign cabin layouts, build production lines, install processing facilities, and unlock advanced crafting formulas. Manage resource stockpiles, arrange production schedules, and assign guard manpower rationally. Achieve mass production of daily materials and combat supplies. Transform the ancient artifact into your portable production hub and unshakable jianghu fortress. 2.4 Tower Defense + Auto-Battler Hybrid Combat Innovatively combining tower defense deployment and auto-battler strategy. Build various defensive towers and combat devices on your deck, each with unique attributes and skills. Towers feature exclusive synergy bonds. Level up to unlock new affixes and advanced bond effects. Mix offense, crowd control, defense, and support to create countless unique combat builds. Adjust formations tactically to fend off bandit raids and sect sieges. 2.5 Global Faction Conquest System Every village and sect on the map is conquerable. Each stronghold provides exclusive specialties, resources, and geographical advantages. Occupy territories to monopolize local production and control vital trade routes for unique development bonuses. Expand your influence like map coloring. Grow from a ruined small bureau into a dominant force, seize villages, subdue sects, and eventually unify the entire Shu territory to build your own jianghu empire. 2.6 Ultimate Open-World Freedom No fixed storyline or forced moral alignment shapes your fate. You can walk the righteous path, escort caravans, uphold justice, and earn legendary fame. Or embrace chaos: steal from towns, cheat in gambles, ambush merchants, plunder villages, and occupy mountains as an outlaw overlord. Freely engage in duels, faction wars, trade competitions, or rural seclusion. Every choice crafts a unique life in this truly open and diverse wuxia world. WORKS: Motorsport Factory is a top-down tycoon sim about everything that happens before a racing car reaches the circuit. Manage a motorsport team from the ground up: staff, facilities, car design and development while trying to stay competitive on a limited budget. Secure sponsors, hire mechanics, source parts and keep the operation running long enough to make it to race day. Five tiers of motorsport stand between your workshop and the being the most prestigious team in motorsport. Progress is not a straight climb - it’s a long-term struggle of financial pressure, technical setbacks and outperforming better-funded rivals. You manage the operation that makes the racing possible. Build the car. Prepare the spares. Manage the crew. Get the right driver in the seat. Load the truck. Get everything out of the factory and to the circuit before the departure deadline. While you wait at the factory the racing happens, watch the timing screens and wait. When the results come in your work begins again worn parts, crash damage and everything you learned about the car. Your crew goes to work. Deliveries arrive. Builders get back to work on the new section of the garage. Every job takes time. Every job needs someone to do it. Where you put things, who you hire, how your workshop is laid out and what your crew is doing right now all matter. The factory isn't a menu. It's a working place. Each part has a story. Each part has a lifespan. A brand new part at race one is not the same at the end of a season. Performance drops off, wear accumulates and eventually a part will fail. Run it too hard and repair it too much and it won't perform the same again. You can design parts for performance, endurance or reliability but getting the right balance to cover all three can be impossible Every part has a breaking point. Every part has a finite mileage lifespan. Every part has a performance drop-off that only reveals itself under real conditions. The better your facilities and the stronger your technical staff, the more of the truth you can uncover. And in a sport where tenths of a second matter, knowledge is often more valuable than raw performance. Five tiers of racing with many routes to reach the top. Whether it's from Karting to Open Wheel or Banger racing to Touring Cars, you're picking the route. Getting into the next series isn't just about winning. Drivers have careers of their own. Animated reconstructions of classic wars Historical War: The Animation is not a real-time strategy game and not a sandbox wargame. It is a library of war films: famous campaigns reconstructed as short, playable records with play, pause, replay, and a scrubbable timeline. Napoleon is the dividing line. His campaigns and everything after are Modern Wars; everything earlier is Ancient Wars. Each film is about five minutes—long enough to follow the main axis of a battle, short enough to finish in one sitting. What you get Animated maps of advances, encirclements, retreats, and naval or air contact A timeline keyed to historical beats, with campaign notes Units that move along operational lines instead of appearing from nowhere Chinese and English interface, switchable at any time Ancient Wars Alexander the Great, the Punic Wars, Cannae, the Qin unification of China, Gaixia and Han Xin’s ten-sided ambush, Caesar, the Crusades, and the Mongol conquests. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly. A brand-new title that's easy to pick up yet packed with strategic depth — blending bullet-hell shooting, inventory management, light Roguelike, and tower defense elements into one addictive experience. Step into a magical world under siege — face wave after wave of relentless monster hordes, build the ultimate hero lineup, construct an unbreakable defense, and protect the world you call home! 🧙 Random Recruitment, Strategic Formations Every run, you'll randomly recruit a unique set of heroes with distinct abilities. How you allocate and upgrade these heroes within limited grid slots is the key to stopping enemy assaults. With 100+ story chapter stages to conquer, every level is a fresh strategic challenge. ⚔️ Deep Hero System, Endless Tactical Combos The game features a rich and deep hero system, with each hero falling into distinct combat roles: Single-Target Burst : Specializes in eliminating elite enemies AOE Damage : Clears out swarms of minions Support & Buff : Provides powerful team-wide reinforcements Each hero occupies a different number of inventory grid slots — making optimal use of limited grid space is an extreme test of your strategic vision. Some heroes, when merged to max level, can evolve into two different branches of super heroes — choosing the right evolution path and team composition is the core of victory. 🛡️ Goddesses Descend, Defend Your Castle You can also recruit goddesses with unique styles. Each goddess possesses randomly generated skill affixes that provide unique buffs to your defense line. Encountering and nurturing each goddess is one of the key factors on the path to victory. 🏰 Castle Upgrades, Unlock Exclusive Skills Your castle can also be upgraded! When you have enough resources, don't forget to upgrade your castle. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop! Easy to pick up, hard to put down: a xianxia Roguelike blending backpack management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks. Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus: Some excel at single-target burst Some excel at AoE damage Some excel at healing and sustain Some excel at crowd control and slow Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer. Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages. Relaxed, Grind-Friendly, and Deeply Strategic Low PC requirements — runs smoothly on most computers One run after another — easy to enjoy, hard to stop Deep strategy for fans of backpack management, build-crafting, tower defense, and bullet-heaven shooting Xianxia setting + Backpack Like + Bullet-Heaven + Strategy Roguelike — all in one This Game Is for You If You Enjoy: Backpack Like / Backpack Management / Backpack Battles-style gameplay Strategic team-building, build-crafting, and Roguelike randomness Bullet-heaven shooting, tower defense, and screen-clearing horde combat Xianxia / cultivation themes, senior brothers, junior sisters, and Dao Body star-up Relaxed, grind-friendly gameplay that you can enjoy for a long time So then — this last pure land is waiting for you to defend it. management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks. Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus: Some excel at single-target burst Some excel at AoE damage Some excel at healing and sustain Some excel at crowd control and slow Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer. Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: Relaxing light roguelike tower defense! Roguelike progression, plant hero growth, selectable super plants, day/night modes. Awakened plants vs zombies—collect plants, unlock skills, upgrade sun economy, defend your home. Low-spec friendly for tower defense and roguelike Build fans. A relaxing, strategic, long-lasting light roguelike tower defense game! The game combines light Roguelike random progression, plant hero development, selectable super plants, and day/night dual modes. If you are looking for a tower defense game, then this title is absolutely for you. 🌍 Worldview: When Plants Awaken, Humanity's Last Hope Is Ignited In the distant future, Earth's sky is shrouded in a thick gray haze, and sunlight grows weaker by the day. Among the ruins of cities, the once-prosperous human civilization has long retreated into underground shelters, while the surface world has been occupied by a mysterious and greedy force — the Zombie Legion. However, just when humanity was on the brink of despair, an unexpected discovery changed everything — the plants have awakened. They have transformed into super plant heroes, vowing to protect this last homeland. You will serve as the commander, leading these awakened plant heroes to resist wave after wave of zombie hordes and defend your home. 🌱 Rich Plant System: Every Plant Is Its Own Independent Tactic The game features a rich plant system. Different plants have different skills, trajectories, attack methods, and corresponding super skills. Whether you prefer long-range sniping, area bombing, slow control, or high-burst instant kills, you can find your own core plant. Trajectory Differences : Straight-line shots, parabolic throws, spread shots, bouncing, piercing, area explosions, and many other attack methods Super Skills : Every plant has an exclusive ultimate skill that can turn the tide at critical moments Plant Encyclopedia : Collect and cultivate different plants to build your own plant legion 🎯 Roguelike Random Progression: Every Run Is a Brand-New Experience Each run allows you to manually choose one plant you like as your super plant to cultivate. Collecting a specified number of specific plants can unlock super plants and their corresponding exclusive powerful skills, helping you clear stages more effectively. In addition, you must be careful of various Boss skills! Selectable Super Plants : Freely choose your core plant at the start of each run and build your own playstyle Random Affixes and Enhancements : Randomly obtain enhancement options after each wave, with Build combinations Unlock Exclusive Skills : Collect specified plants to unlock the ultimate exclusive skills of super plants ☀️ Sun Orb Economy: Tempo Control Is the Key to Victory The number of sun orbs in the game is very important. Unlocking more sun orbs at the right time can yield twice the result with half the effort. Reasonably allocate sun orbs to balance in-battle economic development and combat power improvement Seize the timing of unlocking to expand battlefield advantages 🌙 Day and Night: Dual-Mode Battlefield The game is divided into day and night game modes. Battlefield environments, enemy behavior, and plant performance all differ under different modes. Different modes bring completely different strategic ideas and stage-clearing experiences If you cannot win, it does not matter. You can accumulate resources in each battle and use accumulated resources to upgrade plants, thereby clearing various difficulty stages 📈 Light Progression + Long-Term Playability: The More You Play, the Stronger You Get, and the Stronger You Get, the More Satisfying It Feels This is a light roguelike tower defense game that can be played for a very long time. Even if you fail a run, you can still gain permanent progression resources and gradually become stronger. Meta Progression : Upgrade plants, unlock new plants, and improve basic attributes Stage Progression : From normal mode to challenge mode, difficulty increases layer by layer Suitable for Long-Term Play : Relaxing and casual, no grinding, no pay-to-win, play a round anytime, anywhere 💻 Low Configuration Requirements: Meets the Needs of Most PC Players In addition, the game does not have high PC configuration requirements and meets the needs of most PC players. Whether you use an office laptop, a thin-and-light laptop, or an old desktop computer, you can run it smoothly and enjoy tower defense fun with ease. 🎮 Core Features at a Glance ✅ Light roguelike tower defense, relaxing strategy, long-term playable ✅ Rich plant system, with different skills, trajectories, and attack methods ✅ Selectable super plants, collect to unlock exclusive powerful skills ✅ Sun orb economy system, tempo control determines victory ✅ Day/night dual modes ✅ Meta progression + resource accumulation, the more you play, the stronger you get ✅ Low configuration requirements, most PCs can run it smoothly 🏷️ Suitable for Players Like You Players who like tower defense games Players who like Roguelike random progression and Build combinations Players who like light strategy, no grinding, no pay-to-win, and slow-paced play Players who like plant heroes, zombie themes, and post-apocalyptic wasteland worldviews Players who like selectable cores + collection unlocks + meta progression Players who want a casual strategy game with low configuration requirements that can be played anytime Plants have awakened, heroes have assembled. Go lead them to protect your homeland! espionaje,detective,impostor,tareas,Pummel Party,juego de fiesta,minijuegos,competición,jugar con amigos,Fall Guys,Chicos Caídos,juego popular en streams de latinoamérica A relaxing, strategic, long-lasting light roguelike tower defense game! The game combines light Roguelike random progression, plant hero development, selectable super plants, and day/night dual modes. If you are looking for a tower defense game, then this title is absolutely for you. 🌍 Worldview: When Plants Awaken, Humanity's Last Hope Is Ignited In the distant future, Earth's sky is shrouded in a thick gray haze, and sunlight grows weaker by the day. Among the ruins of cities, the once-prosperous human civilization has long retreated into underground shelters, while the surface world has been occupied by a mysterious and greedy force — the Zombie Legion. However, just when humanity was on the brink of despair, an unexpected discovery changed everything — the plants have awakened. They have transformed into super plant heroes, vowing to protect this last homeland. You will serve as the commander, leading these awakened plant heroes to resist wave after wave of zombie hordes and defend your home. 🌱 Rich Plant System: Every Plant Is Its Own Independent Tactic The game features a rich plant system. Different plants have different skills, trajectories, attack methods, and corresponding super skills. Whether you prefer long-range sniping, area bombing, slow control, or high-burst instant kills, you can find your own core plant. Trajectory Differences : Straight-line shots, parabolic throws, spread shots, bouncing, piercing, area explosions, and many other attack methods Super Skills : Every plant has an exclusive ultimate skill that can turn the tide at critical moments Plant Encyclopedia : Collect and cultivate different plants to build your own plant legion 🎯 Roguelike Random Progression: Every Run Is a Brand-New Experience Each run allows you to manually choose one plant you like as your super plant to cultivate. Collecting a specified number of specific plants can unlock super plants and their corresponding exclusive powerful skills, helping you clear stages more effectively. In addition, you must be careful of various Boss skills! Selectable Super Plants : Freely choose your core plant at the start of each run and build your own playstyle Random Affixes and Enhancements : Randomly obtain enhancement options after each wave, with Build combinations Unlock Exclusive Skills : Collect specified plants to unlock the ultimate exclusive skills of super plants ☀️ Sun Orb Economy: Tempo Control Is the Key to Victory The number of sun orbs in the game is very important. Unlocking more sun orbs at the right time can yield twice the result with half the effort. Reasonably allocate sun orbs to balance in-battle economic development and combat power improvement Seize the timing of unlocking to expand battlefield advantages 🌙 Day and Night: Dual-Mode Battlefield The game is divided into day and night game modes. Battlefield environments, enemy behavior, and plant performance all differ under different modes. Different modes bring completely different strategic ideas and stage-clearing experiences If you cannot win, it does not matter. You can accumulate resources in each battle and use accumulated resources to upgrade plants, thereby clearing various difficulty stages 📈 Light Progression + Long-Term Playability: The More You Play, the Stronger You Get, and the Stronger You Get, the More Satisfying It Feels This is a light roguelike tower defense game that can be played for a very long time. Even if you fail a run, you can still gain permanent progression resources and gradually become stronger. Meta Progression : Upgrade plants, unlock new plants, and improve basic attributes Stage Progression : From normal mode to challenge mode, difficulty increases layer by layer Suitable for Long-Term Play : Relaxing and casual, no grinding, no pay-to-win, play a round anytime, anywhere 💻 Low Configuration Requirements: Meets the Needs of Most PC Players In addition, the game does not have high PC configuration requirements and meets the needs of most PC players. Whether you use an office laptop, a thin-and-light laptop, or an old desktop computer, you can run it smoothly and enjoy tower defense fun with ease. 🎮 Core Features at a Glance ✅ Light roguelike tower defense, relaxing strategy, long-term playable ✅ Rich plant system, with different skills, trajectories, and attack methods ✅ Selectable super plants, collect to unlock exclusive powerful skills ✅ Sun orb economy system, tempo control determines victory ✅ Day/night dual modes ✅ Meta progression + resource accumulation, the more you play, the stronger you get ✅ Low configuration requirements, most PCs can run it smoothly 🏷️ Suitable for Players Like You Players who like tower defense games Players who like Roguelike random progression and Build combinations Players who like light strategy, no grinding, no pay-to-win, and slow-paced play Players who like plant heroes, zombie themes, and post-apocalyptic wasteland worldviews Players who like selectable cores + collection unlocks + meta progression Players who want a casual strategy game with low configuration requirements that can be played anytime Plants have awakened, heroes have assembled. Go lead them to protect your homeland!
